title: The Broken TTL + LRU Cache
description: Feature flags go stale, hot entries disappear, and false-valued flags are repeatedly fetched.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: TTLCache has positive integer capacity and positive TTL, with an injectable clock. Entries expire at expires_at <= now. Reads refresh recency, not TTL. Writes refresh TTL and recency. Updating a key must not evict another key. len counts only live entries; eviction removes the least recently used live key. None denotes a miss; stored flag values are non-None and may include False, 0, or an empty string.
constraints: Use only the language standard library; no network access or external packages.
The provided tests are read-only; additional private tests verify edge cases.
